fact: On 26 March 2025 the Inspector General asked development partners in Nairobi for Sh20 billion to digitise police operations, the rollout of a digital Occurrence Book included: Sh11 billion for network connectivity, Sh4 billion for digitising police and citizen records, Sh3.5 billion for ICT equipment and Sh0.93 billion for software; he said the system would be operational within two months, and the work follows the reform strategy of the National Task Force on Police Reforms.
title: National Police Service seek Sh20 billion to digitize operations
